content.en: Pick a Question Master (QM): announce a category → deal the same title to every artist except one X card → name the first artist. QM never draws; the X holder is the Fake Artist.
content.zh: 选 1 人做出题者（QM）：公开类别 → 除 1 人外发相同题目，1 人拿 X（伪艺术家）→ 指定首位画家。QM 不画画。

content.en: Take turns clockwise. On your turn, add one continuous line, then pass the paper. Real Artists leave a recognisable clue without saying the title.
content.zh: 按顺时针轮流。轮到你时只画一条连续线，然后传纸。真艺术家留下可辨认的线索，但不能说出题目。

alt.en: Artists add one continuous mark each to a shared drawing
alt.zh: 艺术家依次给共同画作添一条连续线

content.en: Go around again in the same order; each artist adds their second and final mark. When everyone has drawn exactly two marks, move on to the vote.
content.zh: 按同一顺序再绕一圈，每人画第二笔。所有艺术家都画满两笔后，进入投票。

content.en: QM counts down 3, 2, 1, point! All artists—including the fake—point at one suspect. The fake is caught only as the sole highest vote; a tie or another top vote means escape.
content.zh: QM 倒数 3、2、1、指！所有艺术家（含伪艺术家）同时指向 1 名嫌疑人。只有成为唯一最高票才被抓；平票或别人最高都算逃脱。

alt.en: The vote determines whether the Fake Artist must guess the title
alt.zh: 投票结果决定伪艺术家是否必须猜题

content.en: The Fake Artist escapes: Fake and QM each score 2 points. Rotate the QM left and begin a new round.
content.zh: 伪艺术家逃脱：伪艺术家与 QM 各得 2 分。QM 向左轮换，开始新一轮。

content.en: Reveal the X card. The Fake Artist gets exactly one guess: correct → Fake and QM +2 each; wrong → every Real Artist +1. Rotate the QM left for the next round.
content.zh: 翻开 X 卡，伪艺术家只能猜 1 次：猜对 → 伪艺术家与 QM 各 +2；猜错 → 每位真艺术家 +1。QM 向左轮换进入下一轮。
